title: Demystifying Real-world LLM Service Freeloading
abstract: arXiv:2611.33218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Third-party projects repackage free inference from LLM web applications and dedicated clients into independent APIs. We refer to such use beyond providers' permitted access, allocation, or redistribution conditions as LLM service freeloading (LSF). However, its scale and underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. We present a systematic measurement study of 513 open-source projects, tracing 1,588 inference paths across 64 upstream LLM services and characterizing their development, dependencies, and operating mechanisms. We find that 93.0% of repositories were created in 2026. Direct HTTP or WebSocket requests account for 83.2% of paths, making reproduction of product protocols the dominant invocation method. Projects adapt messages, reconstruct conversation state, and convert responses to support compatible APIs. translated_title: 揭秘真实世界中的LLM服务“白嫖”现象
translated_abstract: 第三方项目将来自大语言模型（LLM）网页应用和专用客户端的免费推理能力重新打包为独立API。我们将这种超出服务提供商所允许的访问、分配或再分发条件的使用行为称为“LLM服务白嫖”（LLM Service Freeloading, LSF）。然而，其规模和底层机制至今仍缺乏充分了解。本文对513个开源项目开展了系统性测量研究，追踪了横跨64个上游LLM服务的1,588条推理路径，并刻画了这些项目的开发情况、依赖关系和运行机制。研究发现，93.0%的相关仓库创建于2026年；直接HTTP或WebSocket请求占全部路径的83.2%，表明复刻产品协议是主要的调用方式。这些项目通过适配消息、重建对话状态和转换响应来支持兼容API。账号选择或轮换出现在304条路径上（占19.1%），使拥有多个可用账号的项目能够在账号之间分配请求。
tldr: 本文通过对513个开源项目、64个上游LLM服务和1,588条推理路径的系统性测量研究，首次揭示了第三方项目通过复刻产品协议将免费LLM网页服务打包为独立API的“服务白嫖”生态的规模、依赖与运行机制。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic measurement study of 513 open-source projects and 1,588 inference paths across 64 upstream LLM services, revealing for the first time the scale, dependencies, and operating mechanisms of "LLM service freeloading," where third parties repackage free inference from LLM web applications into independent APIs.
